_comment: Rate limiting for BMBA at Cloudflare edge (coarse: by IP/header). Fine-grained per-user limits must be enforced in the Backend (api_check_rate — next slice). Tied to docs/admin-api-contract.md sections.
layer_model: CF coarse -> Backend per-user -> Auth -> RBAC -> Scope -> Approval

policies.comment: OTP + 2FA verify — block 10m on violation (anti-brute). Contract §4.
Prediction submit/edit. Peak: closing predictions (match day). Per-user limit in Backend. Contract §13.
Bursty (Quiz launch). Edge absorbs; Backend per-user. Contract §19.
Sensitive: adjust/freeze. Enforce Idempotency-Key (§35) in Backend. Contract §15.
Low global ceiling; add Cloudflare Access + IP allowlist. Backend RBAC/scope/approval still the gate. Contract §5–§10.
Public reads — high ceiling + edge caching (see caching.json) absorbs match-day peaks. Contract §12.
Public rankings — cache with short TTL. Contract §26.

match_start: caching + edge limits + backend per-user limit
predictions_close: high edge burst allowance + short-TTL caching
results_and_ranking_update: cache invalidation on result, queue for recalculation
challenge_or_quiz_launch: edge absorbs via cache + limits; worker possible
big_campaigns_notifications: pre-warm cache, raise edge ceilings temporarily
